description: This file contains the implementation of the OrderStatus class within the Opencart Admin Model Localisation namespace. The class provides methods for managing order status entities in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving order status data and descriptions. It interacts with the database and caching system to perform CRUD operations and supports localization features such as multiple languages.
external_files: DB_PREFIX (constant or variable used for table prefix)

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Class managing order status data, including creation, updates, deletions, and retrieval, with support for localization.

methods.name: addOrderStatus
methods.description: Adds a new order status in multiple languages, inserting into the database and updating the cache.

methods.name: editOrderStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing order status and its descriptions, removing previous data and caching.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatus
methods.description: Deletes an order status by its ID and clears related cache entries.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all order status descriptions for a specific language ID and clears cache.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order status by its ID, considering the current language setting.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of order statuses, optionally sorted and paginated based on provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalOrderStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of order statuses available for the current language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions of an order status across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches order status descriptions for a specified language ID.
